controls.label: Query matrix Q
controls.help: Edits both query rows; changes dot-product scores and every downstream weight and output.

controls.label: Key matrix K
controls.help: Edits both key rows; changes dot-product scores and every downstream weight and output.

controls.label: Value matrix V
controls.help: Edits both value rows; changes the weighted output while the attention weights stay fixed.

controls.label: Apply 1/sqrt(d_k) scaling
controls.help: Divides dot-product scores by sqrt(d_k); changes the score heatmap, the weight sharpness, and how strongly the output mixes value rows.

visuals.title: Each weight row sums to one

explorations.title: Equal similarity gives uniform weights
explorations.instruction: Predict: when both queries have identical dot products against both keys, what weights appear? Then apply the preset, which sets the query and key matrices and turns scaling on.
explorations.observe: The score heatmap is flat, the weight heatmap shows 0.5 in every cell, the row-sum bars read 1.0, and the output rows equal the average of the two value rows.
explorations.why: Equal scores keep both exponentials identical, so softmax splits probability evenly; the row-sum intermediate confirms normalization.

explorations.title: Large dot products sharpen without scaling
explorations.instruction: Predict: when one query-key dot product is much larger than the other, how does turning scaling off change the weight split? Then apply the preset, which sets a dominant score and turns scaling off.
explorations.observe: The first score row shows a large value and a zero; the weights become nearly 1 and 0; row sums still read 1.0; the first output row approaches the first value row of 5 and 0.
explorations.why: Scaling divides scores by sqrt(d_k). Turning it off leaves larger scores, so softmax saturates and assigns almost all weight to the dominant key.
